# ENCE - Serial vs Sync vs C Plots

## Setup

```{r setup, message=FALSE}
cutoff <- 0.50

tag         <- sprintf("cutoff%02d", round(cutoff * 100))
results_file <- sprintf("section_4_2_ENCE_C_implementation_%s.rds", tag)
log_file     <- sprintf("section_4_2_ENCE_C_implementation_%s.txt", tag)

ence <- readRDS(results_file)
```

## Helper Functions

```{r helper_functions, message=FALSE}
report_metrics <- function(true, pred, method_name, elapsed) {
  rmse <- sqrt(mean((pred - true)^2))
  cat(method_name, "\n", sep = "")
  cat("Time:  ", round(elapsed, 2), "seconds\n")
  cat("RMSE:  ", rmse, "\n")
  cat("Bias %:", sum(pred - true) / sum(true) * 100, "\n")
  cat("R2:    ", 1 - sum((pred - true)^2) / sum((true - mean(true))^2), "\n")
  cat("SRMSE: ", rmse / mean(true), "\n\n")
}

plot_obs_pred <- function(observed, predicted, method_name = "Method") {
  op <- par(pty = "s")
  on.exit(par(op))
  lims <- range(c(observed, predicted), na.rm = TRUE)
  plot(observed, predicted,
       xlim = lims, ylim = lims,
       xlab = "Observed", ylab = "Predicted",
       main = paste(method_name, ": Observed vs Predicted"),
       pch = 16, cex = 0.5, col = rgb(0, 0, 0, 0.12))
  abline(0, 1, col = "red", lwd = 2, lty = 2)
  grid()
}
```

## Unpack

```{r unpack, results='hold'}
meta <- ence$meta
cat("ENCE Section 4.2.1\n")
cat("cutoff:", meta$cutoff, " K:", meta$K, " seed:", meta$seed,
    " stations:", meta$n_stations, " observed:", meta$n_observed,
    " n_years:", length(meta$years),
    " years:", paste(meta$years, collapse = ", "), "\n\n")
cat("description:", meta$description, "\n")
cat("run_time:   ", format(meta$run_time), "\n")
cat("hostname:   ", meta$hostname, " job:", meta$slurm_job_id,
    " nodelist:", meta$slurm_nodelist, "\n")
cat("R version:  ", meta$r_version, "\n\n")

true_y   <- ence$true_y
serial_y <- ence$serial_y
sync_y   <- ence$sync_y
C_y      <- ence$C_y

serial_rmse <- ence$serial_rmse
sync_rmse   <- ence$sync_rmse
C_rmse      <- ence$C_rmse

serial_val_list <- ence$serial_val_list
sync_val_list   <- ence$sync_val_list
C_val_list      <- ence$C_val_list

n_cut <- min(sapply(serial_val_list, length), sapply(sync_val_list, length), sapply(C_val_list, length))
serial_val <- rowMeans(sapply(serial_val_list, function(v) v[1:n_cut]))
sync_val   <- rowMeans(sapply(sync_val_list,   function(v) v[1:n_cut]))
C_val      <- rowMeans(sapply(C_val_list,      function(v) v[1:n_cut]))
```

```{r metrics, results='hold'}
report_metrics(true_y, serial_y, "Serial", ence$serial_time)
report_metrics(true_y, sync_y,   "Synchronous", ence$sync_time)
report_metrics(true_y, C_y,      "C implementation", ence$C_time)
```

## Timings

```{r timings, results='hold'}
serial_time_vec <- ence$serial_time_vec
sync_time_vec   <- ence$sync_time_vec
C_time_vec      <- ence$C_time_vec

cat("Per-fold wall time (s):\n")
print(rbind(serial = round(serial_time_vec, 2),
            sync   = round(sync_time_vec, 2),
            C      = round(C_time_vec, 2)))

speedup_C_serial <- serial_time_vec / C_time_vec
speedup_C_sync   <- sync_time_vec   / C_time_vec
speedup_sync_serial <- serial_time_vec / sync_time_vec

cat("\nPer-fold speedup, mean +/- sd:\n")
cat("C vs serial:   ", round(mean(speedup_C_serial), 2), "+/-", round(sd(speedup_C_serial), 2), "\n")
cat("C vs sync:     ", round(mean(speedup_C_sync), 2), "+/-", round(sd(speedup_C_sync), 2), "\n")
cat("sync vs serial:", round(mean(speedup_sync_serial), 2), "+/-", round(sd(speedup_sync_serial), 2), "\n\n")
```

## Scatterplots

```{r scatterplots, results='hold'}
plot_obs_pred(true_y, serial_y, "Serial")
plot_obs_pred(true_y, sync_y,   "Synchronous")
plot_obs_pred(true_y, C_y,      "C implementation")
```

## Convergence

```{r convergence_plot, results='hold'}
col_serial <- "#234ec2"
col_sync   <- "#c20d0d"
col_C      <- "#1c9e5b"

xlim_range <- c(1, max(length(serial_rmse), length(sync_rmse), length(C_rmse)))
plot(serial_rmse, type = "b", col = col_serial, pch = 15,
     xlim = xlim_range,
     ylim = range(c(serial_rmse, sync_rmse, C_rmse)),
     xlab = "Cycle", ylab = "Internal RMSE (between cycles)",
     main = "Convergence: Serial vs Sync vs C")
grid()
lines(serial_rmse, type = "b", col = col_serial, pch = 15)
lines(sync_rmse,   type = "b", col = col_sync,   pch = 17)
lines(C_rmse,      type = "b", col = col_C,      pch = 18)
legend("topright", legend = c("Serial", "Synchronous", "C"),
       col = c(col_serial, col_sync, col_C), pch = c(15, 17, 18), lty = 1)
```

```{r val_rmse_plot, results='hold'}
col_serial <- "#eb7500"
col_sync   <- "#7008d1"
col_C      <- "#0d8fc2"

xlim_range <- c(1, max(length(serial_val), length(sync_val), length(C_val)))
plot(serial_val, type = "b", col = col_serial, pch = 15,
     xlim = xlim_range,
     ylim = range(c(serial_val, sync_val, C_val)),
     xlab = "Cycle", ylab = "Validation RMSE (masked cells)",
     main = "Validation RMSE: Serial vs Sync vs C")
grid()
lines(serial_val, type = "b", col = col_serial, pch = 15)
lines(sync_val,   type = "b", col = col_sync,   pch = 17)
lines(C_val,      type = "b", col = col_C,      pch = 18)
legend("topright", legend = c("Serial", "Synchronous", "C"),
       col = c(col_serial, col_sync, col_C), pch = c(15, 17, 18), lty = 1)
```
